name: Worth Investment & Trading Company Limited
about: Worth Investment & Trading Company Limited operates as a finance and investment company in India. The company invests to acquire, sell, transfer, subscribe for, hold, and otherwise deal in, and investing in any shares, bonds, and stocks issued or guaranteed by any company. It also provides financial assistance, investment advisory, portfolio management, trading, and research and analysis services. Worth Investment & Trading Company Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Thane, India.
